message.content:
Based on a detailed forensic analysis of the provided **Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Sick Leave Report** (Seha/Mawid system), here is the precise extraction of every formatting specification.

### 1. PAGE SPECIFICATIONS
*   **Page Size:** Standard **A4** (210mm x 297mm).
*   **Orientation:** Portrait.
*   **Margins:**
    *   Left/Right: ~20mm (generous whitespace for official document look).
    *   Top: ~25mm.
    *   Bottom: ~15mm.
*   **Background Color:** Solid **White (#FFFFFF)**. No texture or watermark visible in the main content area.

### 2. HEADER SECTION
*   **Left Logo (Seha):**
    *   **Content:** Arabic text "صحة" (Seha) with a blue checkmark icon composed of horizontal lines.
    *   **Position:** Top-left quadrant, approximately **(x: 45mm, y: 35mm)** from top-left corner.
    *   **Size:** Width approx **40mm**, Height approx **25mm**.
    *   **Color:** Primary Blue (#0077C8) and Dark Grey/Black.
*   **Right Graphic (Decorative):**
    *   **Content:** Abstract geometric wireframe pattern (resembling a connected network or low-poly mesh).
    *   **Position:** Top-right area, approximately **(x: 160mm, y: 30mm)**.
    *   **Size:** Approx **50mm x 40mm**.
    *   **Color:** Very light grey/blue (#E0E0E0), subtle opacity.
*   **Spacing:** Significant gap (~60mm) between the Seha logo and the central Title block.

### 3. TITLE SECTION
*   **Arabic Main Title (Emblem):**
    *   **Text:** "المملكة العربية السعودية" (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia - in Thuluth/Official script style).
    *   **Font Size:** Approx **18pt - 20pt**.
    *   **Weight:** Bold/Regular (depends on specific font file, appears as standard weight for this emblem).
    *   **Color:** Black (#000000) or very dark grey.
    *   **Alignment:** Center.
*   **English Sub-Title (Emblem):**
    *   **Text:** "Kingdom of Saudi Arabia".
    *   **Font Size:** Approx **10pt - 11pt**.
    *   **Weight:** Regular.
    *   **Color:** Dark Grey (#333333).
    *   **Spacing:** Tightly below Arabic emblem (~2-3pt gap).
*   **Document Title (Arabic):**
    *   **Text:** "تقرير إجازة مرضية".
    *   **Font Size:** Approx **22pt - 24pt**.
    *   **Weight:** **Bold**.
    *   **Color:** Primary Blue (**#0077C8** or similar).
    *   **Position:** Centered, below the Emblem block.
*   **Document Title (English):**
    *   **Text:** "Sick Leave Report".
    *   **Font Size:** Approx **16pt - 18pt**.
    *   **Weight:** **Bold**.
    *   **Color:** Dark Grey/Black (**#333333**).
    *   **Position:** Centered, directly below Arabic title.
    *   **Spacing between Titles:** ~4-6pt.

### 4. TABLE STRUCTURE
*   **Table Position:** Starts at approx **(x: 35mm, y: 110mm)**.
*   **Total Table Width:** Approx **140mm** (spans most of the page width between margins).
*   **Column Layout (3 Columns):**
    1.  **Left Column (Arabic Label):** Width ~**28mm** (20%).
    2.  **Middle Column (Values):** Width ~**84mm** (60%).
        *   *Sub-split:* For rows with dual dates (Leave Duration), it splits into two equal sub-columns of ~42mm each.
    3.  **Right Column (English Label):** Width ~**28mm** (20%).
*   **Row Heights:**
    *   Standard Rows (Leave ID, Admission, Discharge): **~12mm - 14mm**.
    *   Highlight Row (Duration): **~14mm - 16mm** (slightly taller to accommodate bold text and padding).
*   **Borders:**
    *   **Outer Border:** Thin solid line, color **Light Grey (#DDDDDD)** or **Blue-Grey (#CCCCCC)**.
    *   **Inner Borders (Vertical):** Same thin solid line separating columns.
    *   **Inner Borders (Horizontal):** Same thin solid line separating rows.
    *   **Style:** Uniform 0.5pt or 1px solid stroke. No rounded corners on the table container itself.
*   **Background Colors:**
    *   **Header/Label Cells (Left & Right):** **White (#FFFFFF)** or extremely faint blue-grey (#F9FBFD).
    *   **Value Cells (Middle):** **White (#FFFFFF)** or faint grey (#F5F5F5) alternating? *Correction:* Visual analysis suggests all value cells are white, but the "Leave Duration" row has a distinct background (see below).
    *   **Special Row (Leave Duration):**
        *   **Label Cells (Left/Right):** **Dark Navy Blue (#1E3A5F or #003366)**.
        *   **Value Cell (Middle):** **White (#FFFFFF)** (or very pale blue tint).

### 5. FONT DETAILS (Per Cell Type)
*   **Label Cells (Right - English):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-Serif (likely **Arial**, **Helvetica**, or **Segoe UI**).
    *   **Size:** **10pt - 11pt**.
    *   **Weight:** **Bold** (for standard rows), **White/Bold** (for dark blue row).
    *   **Color:** **Dark Blue (#005580)** (standard row), **White (#FFFFFF)** (dark blue row).
*   **Label Cells (Left - Arabic):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-Serif (likely **Segoe UI**, **Dubai**, or **Arial Unicode**).
    *   **Size:** **10pt - 11pt**.
    *   **Weight:** **Bold**.
    *   **Color:** **Dark Blue (#005580)** (standard row), **White (#FFFFFF)** (dark blue row).
    *   **Alignment:** Right-aligned within the cell.
*   **Value Cells (Middle):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-Serif (**Arial/Helvetica** for EN, **Segoe UI/Dubai** for AR).
    *   **Size:** **9pt - 10pt**.
    *   **Weight:** **Regular** (or Medium).
    *   **Color:** **Black (#000000)** or **Dark Grey (#222222)**.
    *   **Duration Row Specifics:** Text is **Bold** and Black.

### 6. TEXT ALIGNMENT
*   **English Labels (Right Column):** **Left Aligned** (with internal padding).
*   **Arabic Labels (Left Column):** **Right Aligned** (with internal padding).
*   **Values (Middle Column):** **Center Aligned**.
    *   *Note:* In the "Leave Duration" row, English date is left-aligned in its sub-column, Arabic date is right-aligned in its sub-column, creating a symmetrical center split.

### 7. CELL PADDING
*   **Horizontal Padding:** Approx **8mm - 10mm** on sides of label cells; **5mm** on sides of value cells.
*   **Vertical Padding:** Approx **4mm - 5mm** top/bottom (centering text vertically).

### 8. FOOTER SECTION
*   **Layout:** Split into Left (QR + Logos) and Right (Text Details) by a vertical divider.
*   **Vertical Divider Line:**
    *   **Position:** Exact center of footer area, approx **x: 105mm**.
    *   **Height:** Approx **40mm - 50mm**.
    *   **Color:** Light Grey (#CCCCCC).
    *   **Style:** Solid thin line.
*   **Left Side (Visual Elements):**
    *   **QR Code:**
        *   **Position:** Bottom-left, approx **(x: 40mm, y: 250mm)**.
        *   **Size:** **25mm x 25mm** (square).
        *   **Style:** Standard black/white QR with quiet zone.
    *   **Hospital Logo (Circular):**
        *   **Position:** To the right of QR code, approx **(x: 75mm, y: 255mm)**.
        *   **Size:** Diameter approx **15mm - 18mm**.
        *   **Content:** Appears to be the specific facility logo (circular badge).
*   **Right Side (Text Information):**
    *   **Hospital Name (Arabic):**
        *   **Text:** [Hospital Name] (e.g., "مستشفى الملك فهد...")
        *   **Position:** Top-right of footer text block.
        *   **Font:** Arabic Sans-Serif, **12pt - 14pt**, **Bold**, **Dark Blue/Black**.
    *   **Hospital Name (English):**
        *   **Text:** [Hospital Name EN]
        *   **Position:** Below Arabic name.
        *   **Font:** Sans-Serif, **10pt - 11pt**, **Bold**, **Grey/Black**.
    *   **License/CR Number:**
        *   **Text:** "رخصة التشغيل: [Number]" / "License No: ..."
        *   **Position:** Below hospital names.
        *   **Font:** **9pt**, Regular, **Grey (#666666)**.
    *   **URL / Verification Link:**
        *   **Text:** "www.seha.sa" or verification URL.
        *   **Position:** Near bottom of text block.
        *   **Font:** **9pt**, Regular, **Blue (#0077C8)** (hyperlink style).
    *   **Timestamp (Bottom Center/Right):**
        *   **Text:** Date/Time of issue (e.g., "2025-09-19 10:30 AM").
        *   **Position:** Absolute bottom right or centered at very bottom edge.
        *   **Font:** **8pt - 9pt**, Light Grey (#999999).
*   **NHIC / Ministry Logo (Bottom Right Corner):**
    *   **Position:** **(x: 185mm, y: 275mm)** (bottom right margin).
    *   **Size:** Approx **15mm x 15mm**.
    *   **Content:** Official regulatory body logo (NHIC - National Health Insurance Company or Ministry of Health).

### 9. SPACING SUMMARY
*   **Header to Title Gap:** ~25mm (large whitespace for official look).
*   **Title to Table Gap:** ~15mm.
*   **Table to Footer Gap:** ~20mm.
*   **Internal Table Row Spacing:** 0px (borders touch).

### 10. ADDITIONAL VISUAL DETAILS
*   **Rounded Corners:** The outer border of the table appears to have **very slight rounding (radius 2-3px)** or is sharp. The image resolution makes it appear mostly sharp but professional forms often use 2-4px radius.
*   **Shadows:** **None**. Flat design aesthetic.
*   **Color Palette:**
    *   Primary: **#0077C8** (Seha Blue)
    *   Secondary: **#1E3A5F** (Navy - used for Duration row header)
    *   Text: **#333333** (Dark Grey)
    *   Borders: **#E0E0E0** (Light Grey)
*   **Directionality:** The document is **bilingual bidirectional**. The structure is symmetric: English labels on the right (LTR context implied by position, though text is LTR), Arabic labels on the right (RTL). Actually, looking closely:
    *   **Right Column:** English Labels (Left-aligned text).
    *   **Left Column:** Arabic Labels (Right-aligned text).
    *   This creates a mirror symmetry around the central Value column.

---
**Technical Note for Replication:**
To recreate this exactly, use an HTML/CSS table or PDF library (like iTextSharp, ReportLab, or wkhtmltopdf) with:
*   `font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif` (for Arabic support).
*   `border-collapse: collapse`.
*   Specific hex codes: **#0077C8** for primary accents, **#1a3c61** for the dark header row.
*   Ensure the "Leave Duration" row uses `background-color: #1a3c31` for label cells and `color: white` for that text.
